title: Can climate change affect our mental health?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why might climate change affect mental health even when a person is not directly hit by a disaster?
Is worry about climate change a reasonable response or can it become unhealthy?
How can people stay engaged with environmental problems without feeling powerless?
Should mental-health services in disaster-prone areas prepare specifically for climate-related stress?
What kind of action helps reduce anxiety more: personal lifestyle changes or collective political action?
